englishOnly: The checks look for English wording, such as "date of birth" or "career objective", so they work on a CV written in English. Length and email checks work in any language.
privacy: Your CV is read in this tab. Nothing is stored.
toFix: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} to fix {for}
otherNote: These checks hold in most countries. Rules for one country, like an ID number or a declaration, are not checked.
textOnly: This checks the text only. It cannot see a photo, columns or fonts. Leave the photo off unless the posting asks for one.

length.title: About {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} long
length.ok: Within the {max} pages most employers {in} expect.
length.fix: Cut to {max} pages {for}. Trim roles older than 10 years to one line each.

email.title: Email address
email.ok: Found. Use a plain firstname.lastname style address.
email.fix: No email found. Put it at the top, next to your phone number.

drop.ok: None found. Good, employers {in} do not expect them.
drop.fix: Remove date of birth, marital status, gender, religion and nationality. Employers {in} do not expect them and they invite bias.

ifAsked.ok: Fine. Add date of birth only when the posting asks for it.
ifAsked.fix: Remove marital status. Add date of birth only when the posting asks for it.

ifAskedNg.ok: Fine. Add date of birth only when the posting asks for it.
ifAskedNg.fix: Remove marital status. Add date of birth or state of origin only when the posting asks for it.

general.ok: Fine. Add date of birth or a photo only if employers in your country expect them.
general.fix: Remove marital status. It has nothing to do with the job.

keep.ok: Fine. Nationality or work permit status and a driver's licence are worth listing in South Africa.
keep.fix: Remove marital status. It has nothing to do with the job.

za.ok: Not on your CV. Share it only when an employer asks.
za.fix: Remove your ID number. Share it when an employer asks, usually at offer stage. It is personal information under POPIA.

ke.ok: Not on your CV. Give it on the application form when asked.
ke.fix: Remove your ID number. Give it on the application form or when an employer asks. It is personal data under the Data Protection Act 2019.

nysc.title: NYSC status
nysc.ok: Found. Employers check it, so keep the year you finished or your exemption.
nysc.fix: Add your NYSC status: completed with the year, exempted, or currently serving.

objective.title: Career objective
objective.fix: Replace the objective with a three line professional summary about what you offer, not what you want.

references.title: References line
references.fix: Delete "references available on request". Employers assume it.
references.fixReferees: Delete "references available on request". Employers assume it. Or list two referees with phone numbers, which is common here.

declaration.title: Declaration
declaration.ok: No declaration line. Fine for private sector roles.
declaration.fix: Drop the "I hereby declare" line unless the posting asks for it. Private sector recruiters skip it.

cta.title: Format fixed. Now fit it to the job.
cta.body: FitMyCV takes this CV and a job link, then rewrites your summary and top bullets for that posting, with a matching cover letter.
cta.label: Tailor my CV to a job
